opening.argument: The opportunity is structured around recruitment, multiple paid positions, and rewards tied to downstream activity. Participants are told, “You create two more IDs and put 550 Euro on each,” while the structure expressly describes successive generations and promises matching bonuses alongside direct-sale benefits. Sponsoring others is presented as the route to those rewards, and the speaker reports, “in three months time I made hundred thousand euros.” The account-in-another-person’s-name example further raises concern, although the records do not establish authorization, completed payments, actual earnings, or resulting losses. The speaker also says that people may join for free and that no one is obligated or forced, but those statements do not remove the central emphasis on paid IDs, recruitment, and commission-linked advancement.
